bio:
I'm Kadir Lofca, I worked on products with 2M+ users, won an IEEE award, and founded Sentzel Labs. 

My work is an extension of my life philosophy — shape your environment, shape yourself. I think in systems and engineer habits to set myself up for success. 

I enjoy owning products and having multiple hats. You can find me working in my office, a coffee shop, or a sidewalk :)
